Welcome to College of San Mateo!
Welcome to College of San Mateo!
Welcome to College of San Mateo!
Welcome to College of San Mateo!

For over 100 years, College of San Mateo (CSM) has been dedicated to fostering excellence, inclusivity, and student success in San Mateo County. CSM serves over 15,000 students annually. We provide holistic student services, an extensive range of degree and certificate programs, and various collegiate sports for all students. Currently serving over 70% of students of color, the College is a designated Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) and an Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institution (AANAPISI). We are proud of our foundations in equity and social justice. CSM strives to build a sense of belonging and culture of success for all. Our vision is to deliver liberatory education that inspires individual achievement and generational impacts.

At CSM, we understand that your success can also be impacted by your environment. We offer comprehensive student support services to guide you through your educational journey. From our Wellness Center to counseling services, athletic center, SparkPoint for basic needs resources, and financial aid services, we aim to support your full experience at CSM. Our campus is a safe, welcoming, and inclusive space for all students, and we invite you to take full advantage of the resources and opportunities available.
On behalf of our campus community, I welcome you to CSM! Let’s go, Bulldogs!

Durante más de 100 años, College of San Mateo (CSM) se ha dedicado a fomentar la excelencia, la inclusión y el éxito estudiantil en el condado de San Mateo. CSM atiende a más de 15.000 estudiantes anualmente. Brindamos servicios integrales para estudiantes, una amplia gama de programas de títulos y certificados, y varios deportes colegiales para todos los estudiantes. Actualmente, el colegio atiende a más del 70% de estudiantes de color y es una institución designada al servicio de los hispanos (HSI) y una institución al servicio de los asiáticos estadounidenses y nativos americanos de las islas del Pacífico (AANAPISI). Estamos orgullosos de nuestros cimientos en equidad y justicia social. CSM se esfuerza por generar un sentido de pertenencia y una cultura de éxito para todos. Nuestra visión es brindar una educación liberadora que inspire logros individuales e impactos generacionales.
